## QUESTION 1

__What was the earliest year that the name ‘Felisha’ was used?__

The earliest the name Felicia was used was in 1910. Filtering the data for all Felicias, grabbing only the name, year, and total, and sorting it in ascending order showed me the earliest one. 

_AI use reflection_
**Link** to the original chat:

**The Impact**  How did using AI impact your learning?

```{python}
# Q1
df.filter(pl.col("name") == "Felicia").select("name", "year", "Total").sort(
    "year", descending=False
)
```
